description: Validate plugin config files (YAML and Lua) with Forge's validator: required fields, allowed values, plugin rules, Lua analysis, and references between the files you send (a boss's powers, a dungeon's bosses). Send each file with its server path, such as "plugins/EliteMobs/custombosses/frost_king.yml", so Forge can tell its type. A reference to a file you did not send is reported as not found in the workspace, which here means this call's files. Up to 50 files per call. Nothing is stored.

path.description: Server path or plugin-relative path, such as "plugins/EliteMobs/powers/frost_nova.lua".

name: validate_config_files
